title: LIFE Compute Cancer Target Database Schema
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the LIFE Compute cancer drug target database. Each entry describes a validated cancer drug target with sequence, structural, pharmacological, and scoring metadata.

id.description: Short canonical gene/protein identifier (e.g. 'TP53', 'EGFR', 'KRAS'). Used as the primary key throughout the LIFE Compute pipeline.

uniprot_id.description: UniProt accession number for the canonical human protein isoform (e.g. 'P04637'). Must correspond to a valid entry in the UniProt/Swiss-Prot database.

protein_name.description: Full recommended protein name as in UniProt (e.g. 'Cellular tumor antigen p53'). Include common aliases and synonyms in parentheses where helpful.

protein_sequence.description: Complete canonical amino acid sequence in single-letter IUPAC code, exactly as in the UniProt canonical sequence entry. No gaps, no modifications, no truncation.

disease_context.description: 1-3 sentence description of the protein's role in cancer: mutation/expression frequency, cancer types affected, and mechanistic basis for therapeutic relevance.

difficulty_tier.description: Drug discovery difficulty on a scale of 1-3. Tier 1: well-characterized druggable pocket, multiple approved drugs, clear SAR. Tier 2: druggable but with resistance issues, selectivity challenges, or complex biology. Tier 3: intrinsically disordered regions, no conventional binding pocket, tumor suppressor reactivation, or 'undruggable' characteristics.

difficulty_rationale.description: Scientific justification for the assigned difficulty tier, including specific structural, biological, or pharmacological factors that make this target easy or challenging.

known_drugs.description: List of clinically relevant or approved drugs targeting this protein. Minimum 2, maximum 6 entries. Approved_year is null for drugs in clinical trials or withdrawn.

name.description: Drug name including generic name and common brand/code name (e.g. 'Osimertinib (AZD9291)').

mechanism.description: Mechanistic description of how the drug interacts with the target and its pharmacological effect.

approved_year.description: Year of first regulatory approval (FDA, EMA, or PMDA). Null if the drug is in clinical trials, is a research tool compound, or was never approved.

scoring_metric.description: The computational scoring metric used to evaluate candidate molecules against this target. 'binding_affinity_kcal_mol' is the standard for most structure-based docking. 'docking_score' is used when empirical force-field scoring is preferred.

target_score_threshold.description: The minimum score value to classify a docking result as a 'hit'. For binding_affinity_kcal_mol, typical values range from -7.0 to -12.0 (more negative = stronger predicted binder). For docking_score, higher positive values indicate better binding.

pdb_id.description: Protein Data Bank (RCSB PDB) accession code for the reference crystal structure used in docking campaigns. Should be a high-resolution apo or holo structure of the relevant functional domain.

active_site_residues.description: List of key residue positions (1-indexed, based on canonical UniProt sequence numbering) defining the active site or primary druggable pocket. Used to constrain docking search space and evaluate pose quality.
